forWhat: Every class at once: where each class's newest assessment stands, answers waiting too long, papers not back, and children who are {colour:red} in more than one subject.

layout.shows: How many things wait on each class. A number opens that class on the right.

One table, a class to a row. It shows where its newest assessments stand and its checks overdue, waiting over {t:across.check_overdue_hours} hours. It shows its papers not back after {t:across.papers_missing_days} days, and children who are {colour:red} in more than one subject.
With no class chosen, the school's totals. A class chosen opens here with the rows behind each number, one tab each, with [[Check them]] for its overdue answers.

jobs.title: Clear what is overdue
steps: Choose a class with checks overdue. On its Overdue tab, press [[Check them]].
On its Not back tab, find the papers still with the children.

buttons.label: Check them
buttons.does: Opens that class's answers waiting for a person.
